DETERMINISM: the user is created per run with a loyalty balance of EXACTLY 0, so ANY points-priced line at qty 1 is a guaranteed shortfall. This replaces the shared LOYALTY_NOBAL_USER, whose balance drifted upward on every earning run (1,044 PTS by 2026-08-05) until no catalog PTS item could exceed it and the case silently PASSED while testing nothing.

FIXTURE SHAPE - do not ""simplify"" it: the seeder creates the user WITH org membership (TechFlow). PTS pricing itself is catalog-scoped and needs no VIP group and no org (proven 2026-08-05: a groups=[]/organizations=[] user saw 39 PTS products at balance 0) - but the ORG is what supplies the shipping ADDRESSES this case needs. A brand-new contact has none, and without an address the cart never reaches a decisive place-order state.",front_url={{FRONT_URL}}
